How to convert a word file to a PDF file using a file path as the first parameter. THere are the main steps involved:

1. Use the appropriate namespaces:

```c#
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.conversion.pdf2office;
```

2. Define the serial number (SN) and key for initialization of the conversion sdk library, the parameter "sn" can be found in the "**conversionsdk_sn.txt**" (the string after "SN=") and the "key" can be found in the "**conversionsdk_key.txt**" (the string after "Sign="):

```c#
string sn = "";
string key = "";
```

3. Initialize the Foxit PDF Conversion SDK:

```c#
ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
{
 return 1;
}
```

4. Set up the Office to PDF conversion settings, start the conversion process:

```c#
using (Office2PDFSettingData setting_data = new Office2PDFSettingData())
{
 // Set the path to the resource folder (ensure the path is valid)
 setting_data.resource_folder_path = "../../../res/office2pdf";
 // Define the callback to notify conversion progress during the conversion process
 Office2PDF.ConvertFromWord("input.docx", "", "output.pdf", setting_data);
}
```

5. Release the Foxit PDF Conversion SDK:

```c#
Library.Release()
```

---

How to convert a PDF file to a Word file by steaming and reader callback. It use a reader callback and filestream. Here are the main steps involved:

1. Use the appropriate namespaces:

```c#
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.conversion.pdf2office;
```

2. Define the serial number (SN) and key for initialization of the conversion sdk library, the parameter "sn" can be found in the "**conversionsdk_sn.txt**" (the string after "SN=") and the "key" can be found in the "**conversionsdk_key.txt**" (the string after "Sign="):

```c#
string sn = "";
string key = "";
```

​	3. Initialize the Foxit PDF Conversion SDK:

```c#
ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
{
 return 1;
}
```

​	4.Define a custom callback class for conversion progress:

```c#
public class CustomConvertCallback : ConvertCallback
{
 public CustomConvertCallback() { }
 public override bool NeedToPause()
 {
 return true;
 }
 public override void ProgressNotify(int converted_count, int total_count)
 {
 }
}
```

5. Set up the PDF to Office conversion settings, define the callback to notify conversion progress during the conversion process and start the conversion process:

```c#
using (PDF2OfficeSettingData setting_data = new PDF2OfficeSettingData())
{
 // Set the path to the metrics data folder (ensure the path is valid)
 setting_data.metrics_data_folder_path = "../../../res/metrics_data";
 // Disable machine learning-based recognition functionality
 setting_data.enable_ml_recognition = false;
 // Define the callback to notify conversion progress during the conversion process
 using (CustomConvertCallback callback = new CustomConvertCallback())
 {
 using (FileReader filereadercallback = new FileReader())
 using (FileStreamCallback fileStreamcallback = new FileStreamCallback())
 {
 // Create a File Reader Callback to load a PDF document.
 filereadercallback.LoadFile("input.pdf");
 // Create a FileStream object to read and write the converted Word file.
 fileStreamcallback.LoadFile("output.docx");
 using (Progressive progressive = PDF2Office.StartConvertToWord(filereadercallback, null, fileStreamcallback, setting_data, callback))
 {
 // Check the conversion progress and continue until it's completed:
 if (progressive.GetRateOfProgress() != 100)
 {
 Progressive.State state = Progressive.State.e_ToBeContinued;
 while (Progressive.State.e_ToBeContinued == state)
 {
 state = progressive.Continue();
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
}
```

6. Release the Foxit PDF Conversion SDK:

```c#
Library.Release();
```

Please ensure that you have the correct paths for the include files and necessary resources.

---

How to convert from a PDF to an RTF file?

No, the SDK does not provide the ability to convert PDF files to RTF files.

---

How to convert a password-free PDF file to a Word file using a file path as the first parameter. The machine learning-based recognition is disable and using convert callback. Here are the main steps involved:

1. Use the appropriate namespaces:

```c#
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.conversion.pdf2office;
```

2. Define the serial number (SN) and key for initialization of the conversion sdk library, the parameter "sn" can be found in the "**conversionsdk_sn.txt**" (the string after "SN=") and the "key" can be found in the "**conversionsdk_key.txt**" (the string after "Sign="):

```c#
string sn = "";
string key = "";
```

3. Initialize the Foxit PDF Conversion SDK:

```c#
ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
{
 return 1;
}
```

4. Define a custom callback class for conversion progress:

```c#
public class CustomConvertCallback : ConvertCallback
{
 public CustomConvertCallback() { }
 public override bool NeedToPause()
 {
 return true;
 }

 public override void ProgressNotify(int converted_count, int total_count)
 {
 }
}
```

5. Set up the PDF to Office conversion settings, define the callback to notify conversion progress during the conversion process and start the conversion process:

```c#
using (PDF2OfficeSettingData setting_data = new PDF2OfficeSettingData())
{
 // Set the path to the metrics data folder (ensure the path is valid)
 setting_data.metrics_data_folder_path = "../../../res/metrics_data";
 // Disable machine learning-based recognition functionality
 setting_data.enable_ml_recognition = false;
 // Define the callback to notify conversion progress during the conversion process
 using (CustomConvertCallback callback = new CustomConvertCallback())
 {
 using (Progressive progressive = PDF2Office.StartConvertToWord("input.pdf", null,"output.docx", setting_data, callback))
 {
 // Check the conversion progress and continue until it's completed:
 if (progressive.GetRateOfProgress() != 100)
 {
 Progressive.State state = Progressive.State.e_ToBeContinued;
 while (Progressive.State.e_ToBeContinued == state)
 {
 state = progressive.Continue();
 }
 }
 }
 }
}
```

6. Release the Foxit PDF Conversion SDK:

```c#
Library.Release()
```

Please ensure that you have the correct paths for the necessary resources, such as the metrics data folder.

How to convert a PDF file with the password "123456" to a Word file by steaming and reader callback. It use a reader callback and filestream. Here are the main steps involved:

1. Use the appropriate namespaces:

```c#
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.conversion.pdf2office;
```

2. Define the serial number (SN) and key for initialization of the conversion sdk library, the parameter "sn" can be found in the "**conversionsdk_sn.txt**" (the string after "SN=") and the "key" can be found in the "**conversionsdk_key.txt**" (the string after "Sign="):

```c#
string sn = "";
string key = "";
```

​	3. Initialize the Foxit PDF Conversion SDK:

```c#

if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
{
 return 1;
}
```

​	4.Define a custom callback class for conversion progress:

```c#
public class CustomConvertCallback : ConvertCallback
{
 public CustomConvertCallback() { }

 {
 return true;
 }

 {
 }
}
```

5. Set up the PDF to Office conversion settings, define the callback to notify conversion progress during the conversion process and start the conversion process:

```c#
using (PDF2OfficeSettingData setting_data = new PDF2OfficeSettingData())
{
 // Set the path to the metrics data folder (ensure the path is valid)
 setting_data.metrics_data_folder_path = "../../../res/metrics_data";
 // Disable machine learning-based recognition functionality
 setting_data.enable_ml_recognition = false;
 // Define the callback to notify conversion progress during the conversion process
 using (CustomConvertCallback callback = new CustomConvertCallback())
 {
 using (FileReader filereadercallback = new FileReader())
 using (FileStreamCallback fileStreamcallback = new FileStreamCallback())
 {
 // Create a File Reader Callback to load a PDF document.
 filereadercallback.LoadFile("input.pdf");
 // Create a FileStream object to read and write the converted Word file.
 fileStreamcallback.LoadFile("output.docx");
 // the password of PDF is 123456 as the second parameter of StartConvertToWord function.
 using (Progressive progressive = PDF2Office.StartConvertToWord(filereadercallback, "123456", fileStreamcallback, setting_data, callback))
 {
 // Check the conversion progress and continue until it's completed:
 if (progressive.GetRateOfProgress() != 100)
 {
 Progressive.State state = Progressive.State.e_ToBeContinued;
 while (Progressive.State.e_ToBeContinued == state)
 {
 state = progressive.Continue();
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
}
```


Please ensure that you have the correct paths for the include files and necessary resources.

---

How to define FileStreamCallback inheriting from StreamCallback for convert a PDF to Word by streaming.

```c#
class FileStreamCallback : StreamCallback
{
 private FileStream file_ = null;
 private int ref_ = 1;
 private long cur_pos_ = 0;
 public Boolean LoadFile(String file_path)
 {
 file_ = new FileStream(file_path, FileMode.Create);
 return true;
 }

 public override bool Flush() {
 this.file_.Flush();
 return true;
 }

 public override long GetPosition() {
 return cur_pos_;
 }
 public override long GetSize() {
 return file_.Length;
 }
 public override bool IsEOF() {
 return cur_pos_ < file_.Length ? false : true;
 }

 public override bool ReadBlock(IntPtr buffer, long offset, uint size) {
 if (file_ == null)
 return false;
 file_.Seek(offset, SeekOrigin.Begin);
 byte[] ys = new byte[size];
 file_.Read(ys, (int)offset, (int)size);
 Marshal.Copy(buffer, ys, 0, (int)size);

 cur_pos_ = offset + size;
 return true;
 }

 public override uint ReadBlock(IntPtr buffer, uint size) {
 if (false == ReadBlock(buffer, 0, size)) return 0;
 return size;
 }

 public override StreamCallback Retain() {
 ref_++;
 return this;
 }

 public override bool WriteBlock(IntPtr buffer, long offset, uint size) {
 if (file_ == null)
 return false;
 file_.Seek(offset, SeekOrigin.Begin);

 byte[] ys = new byte[size];
 Marshal.Copy(buffer, ys, 0, (int)size);
 file_.Write(ys, (int)0, (int)size);

 cur_pos_ = offset + size;
 return true;
 }

 public override void Release()
 {
 if (file_ == null) return;
 ref_--;
 if (ref_ > 0) return;
 this.file_.Close();
 }
}

```

How to convert a password-free Word file to a PDF file using a Reader Callback to read wrod file and using a filesteam to write PDF file contents.Here are the main steps involved:

1. Use the appropriate namespaces:

```c#
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.conversion.pdf2office;
```

2. Define the serial number (SN) and key for initialization of the conversion sdk library, the parameter "sn" can be found in the "**conversionsdk_sn.txt**" (the string after "SN=") and the "key" can be found in the "**conversionsdk_key.txt**" (the string after "Sign="):

```c#
string sn = "";
string key = "";
```

3. Initialize the Foxit PDF Conversion SDK:

```c#
ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
{
 return 1;
}
```

4. Set up the Office to PDF conversion settings, start the conversion process:

```c#
using (Office2PDFSettingData setting_data = new Office2PDFSettingData())
{
 // Set the path to the resource folder (ensure the path is valid)
 setting_data.resource_folder_path = "../../../res/office2pdf";
 // Create a File Reader Callback to load a word document.
 using (FileReader filereadercallback = new FileReader())
 // Create a FileStream object to read and write the converted PDF file.
 using (FileStreamCallback fileStreamcallback = new FileStreamCallback())
 {
 filereadercallback.LoadFile("input.docx");
 fileStreamcallback.LoadFile("output.pdf");
 Office2PDF.ConvertFromWord(filereadercallback, null, fileStreamcallback, setting_data);
 }
}
```

5. Release the Foxit PDF Conversion SDK:

```c#
Library.Release()
```

How to convert a password-free Excel file to a PDF file using a Reader Callback to read Excel file and using a filesteam to write PDF file contents.Here are the main steps involved:

1. Use the appropriate namespaces:

```c#
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.conversion.pdf2office;
```

2. Define the serial number (SN) and key for initialization of the conversion sdk library, the parameter "sn" can be found in the "**conversionsdk_sn.txt**" (the string after "SN=") and the "key" can be found in the "**conversionsdk_key.txt**" (the string after "Sign="):

```c#
string sn = "";
string key = "";
```

3. Initialize the Foxit PDF Conversion SDK:

```c#
ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
{
 return 1;
}
```

4. Set up the Office to PDF conversion settings, start the conversion process:

```c#
using (Office2PDFSettingData setting_data = new Office2PDFSettingData())
{
 // Set the path to the resource folder (ensure the path is valid)
 setting_data.resource_folder_path = "../../../res/office2pdf";
 // Create a File Reader Callback to load a word document.
 using (FileReader filereadercallback = new FileReader())
 // Create a FileStream object to read and write the converted PDF file.
 using (FileStreamCallback fileStreamcallback = new FileStreamCallback())
 {
 filereadercallback.LoadFile("input.xlsx");
 fileStreamcallback.LoadFile("output.pdf");
 Office2PDF.ConvertFromExcel(filereadercallback, null, fileStreamcallback, setting_data);
 }
}
```

5. Release the Foxit PDF Conversion SDK:

```c#
Library.Release()
```

---

How to define FileReader inheriting from FileReaderCallback for convert a PDF to Word by streaming.

```c#
class FileReader : FileReaderCallback
{
 private FileStream file_ = null;

 public FileReader()
 {
 }

 public Boolean LoadFile(String file_path)
 {
 file_ = new FileStream(file_path, FileMode.OpenOrCreate);
 return true;
 }

 public override long GetSize()
 {
 return file_.Length;
 }

 public override bool ReadBlock(IntPtr buffer, long offset, uint size)
 {
 int read_size = 0;
 file_.Seek(offset, SeekOrigin.Begin);
 byte[] array = new byte[size + 1];
 read_size = file_.Read(array, 0, (int)size);
 Marshal.Copy(array, 0, buffer, (int)size);
 return read_size == size ? true : false;
 }

 public override void Release()
 {
 this.file_.Close();
 }
}
```
